description: Kick punch preset. Body plus beater attack, boxiness removed. Minimal reverb; stays upfront and centered.
name: kick-hit
notes: Precondition: Kick track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/kick-hit.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling (drop Punch call if unsupported).
Box cut / click boost / sub cut are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Dry by design: no send.set calls; kick stays upfront.
